title: Recognized for changing code-quality culture across the campus's businesses
summary: A Software Center of Excellence leader recognized my code-quality drives and workshops with teams across the campus, and credited them with cultural change across its businesses.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a recognition event, not an intervention.
what_i_did: Ran code-quality drives and hands-on workshops with teams across businesses in the first half of 2019.

quotes.text: Thank you for your good contributions in 'Moving the needle' on Code Quality, resulting in cultural changes across the businesses in PIC.
